lines.en: I walk slowly, as if in a dream.
My robe drags along the ground.
I walk the edge of the village.
My steps are light, almost silent.
Something beats its wings behind me.
My hand moves, and it is not my will.
I pause by the fence.
My pace has been changed.
I walk without watching the path.
I step, steadily.
My fingers move inside my sleeve.
I head for the far side of the village.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方没人说话
lines.en: No one speaks where I pass.
I stop, then go on.
I stand with my eyes half shut.
It is very quiet in my head.
Something rests behind me.
I no longer think of those things.
The wind lifts my hem.

lines.zh: 我一口气一口气地慢慢呼吸
lines.en: I breathe slowly, breath by breath.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸了摸自己的脸
lines.en: I touch my own face.
This place is strangely peaceful.
I stand and do nothing.

lines.zh: 我听见翅膀收拢的声音
lines.en: I hear wings folding.

lines.zh: 我想不起来以前的事了
lines.en: I cannot recall what came before.
All the tension has left me.
You watch me, and I do not want to move.
I know you, and I bear you no ill will.
There is no hostility in my eyes.

lines.zh: 你听见我背后的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the sound behind me?
I have not spoken to anyone in a long while.
It is all right if you come closer.

lines.zh: 我的袍子下藏着别的东西
lines.en: Something else hides beneath my robe.
I give a slow nod.
You may pass.
I give half a step.
I never struck back.
The corner of my robe is split.

lines.zh: 被寄生的幻术师，疼得很轻。
lines.en: A possessed illusioner registers pain lightly.
I hold my sleeve together.
I look down at myself.
The wings behind me tighten.
I take one steadying breath.

lines.zh: 我肚子里有别的虫在动。
lines.en: Something else is stirring inside me.
I am not hungry in the least.
I draw my hand back into my sleeve.
That means nothing to me.
I shake my head slowly.
I am not what I was.
I do not want to take anything.
Thank you, but I need not.
You crashed into me.
There is no anger in me.
You are standing on my robe.
I step back, calmly.
I steady you with one hand.
I straighten my sleeve.
Are you hurt at all?

lines.zh: 长袍的缝隙里，蝶翅轻轻扇动。
lines.en: Through a gap in my robe, butterfly wings flutter softly.
My mind is on other things.
I am quiet and do not wish to talk.
I shake my head and say nothing more.
A voice tells me to leave it.
I keep to myself.
I am at peace now.
Go and ask someone else.
I walk slowly away.
Such thoughts should not be here.
I bend and pick it up.
I look, then hand it back.
This belongs to you.
Wings beat beneath the brim of my hat.
My hands are not steady.
I pick it up and forget to put it down.

lines.zh: 我拿了一会儿才想起来
lines.en: I hold it a while before remembering.
This weighs almost nothing.
I have no use for this.
You are far too close to me.
I raise my head, and my eyes are empty.
Something tells me not to strike.
I watch you, but do not move.
You remind me of before.
The wings behind me have opened.
I am not sure what to do.
I raise a hand and stop.
I am holding myself back hard.
I never once look away.
My fingers are trembling.
A voice is speaking to me.
I silently count your steps.
Just take one step back.
The wings behind me have not stopped.

lines.zh: 我不确定那是不是我的想法
lines.en: I am not sure that thought is mine.
I am waiting for you to go first.
One last time: step back.
There was no killing intent in it.
I raise my arm and turn you aside.
I pulled the force back.
I did not mean to hurt you.
My hand will not stop shaking.
Do not press me any further.

lines.zh: 这一下是那个声音让的
lines.en: That came from the voice.
I step away.

lines.zh: 我从村子的阴影里走出来
lines.en: I step out of the village's shadow.
I came clinging to someone.
Everyone here is quiet.
I stand at the crossing without moving.
Wings rustle behind me.
There is no dust on my robe.
I was not like this before.

lines.zh: 我把头一点一点抬起来
lines.en: I lift my head by degrees.
Not even the dogs bark.
I am waiting for someone here.
Flame licks at my hem.
I fall off the fence.
Water fills my mouth and nose.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的袍子掀起来
lines.en: The blast throws my robe open.
The arrow sinks into my robe. The blood is green.

lines.zh: 魔法让我脑子一阵发白
lines.en: Magic whites out my mind.

lines.zh: 我很久没好好吃过东西
lines.en: I have not eaten properly in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷落在村口，我的袍子烧了
lines.en: Lightning strikes the gate and my robe burns.
There is nothing under my feet.
